title: [3.14] gh-151471: Colorize the soft keyword `type` in IDLE (GH-151700)
body:
`type` is now colored as a keyword when it starts a statement and is followed by a name, as in `type Point = tuple[float, float]`. It stays a builtin elsewhere, for example in `type = type(1)`, `type(x)` or `type in (int, str)`.

(cherry picked from commit 68ed7a50226f8981788f2673677e30f1431e18a9)

Co-authored-by: Shixian Li <znsoooo@gmail.com>
